Author: Xsyy

[size=4]Requested by Harold45.[/size]
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]Simple Mine Loot[/color][/b][/size]
[size=5][b][color=#F2C879]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]PC • Host-only multiplayer supported • Split-screen inactive • Android untested.[/size][/center]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]⛏️ Bonus Loot[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Add temporary loot containers to newly generated ordinary Mines and Skull Cavern floors. Single-player uses chests, breakable crates and barrels; multiplayer uses native shared chests for every selected reward type.

Separate supplies and valuable-chest pools control entries, quantities, categories and rare rewards. Supplies favour resources/monster drops; valuable chests favour gems, geodes and processed materials rather than common filler. Progression can unlock stronger rewards at deeper floors.

Defaults: 100% floor chance, 1–2 containers, 1–3 loot entries and 1–5 units per entry. Adjustable ranges are 0–100%, 1–10 containers, 1–20 entries and 1–50 units. Equipment stays at one. Crate/barrel/chest weights default to 45/45/10; weights are relative, not floor percentages. Valuable chest rewards default to at most one per floor, adjustable to ten.[/size]

[center][url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54045/54045-1792257896-1182844786.png][img width=760]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54045/54045-1792257896-1182844786.png[/img][/url][/center]
[size=4][i]Isolated native mine preview with controlled container placement; not live gameplay.[/i][/size]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🎮 Use, Multiplayer & Settings[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Open chests with the normal Action control; break single-player crates/barrels. Multiplayer chest contents drop onto the ground once and are shared, not duplicated. Only the host needs this mod or SMAPI; farmhands can trigger generation by entering a new floor. The host supplies settings.

Use optional GMCM or edit config.json while the game is closed. Future floor attempts use changed settings. sml_status on the host reports the last placement attempt; it does not create or refill loot. Re-entering a generated floor does not refill it.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]⚠️ Important Limits[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Collect loot before leaving: bonus containers disappear when floors unload/reset and are removed before saving. They are not permanent storage. Clear space is required; a successful chance roll does not guarantee the configured count fits.

Reward/treasure rooms, infested/dinosaur floors, Quarry Mine, custom side branches and Volcano Dungeon are excluded. Pools use curated vanilla items, not arbitrary modded items. Artifacts/equipment also require Rare loot; empty pools are skipped. Categories and rare loot remain respected when depth progression is disabled.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]📦 Requirements & Credits[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.5.2+. Extract SimpleMineLoot into Mods; preserve config.json when updating. In co-op, install on the host only. Includes twelve languages. Generative AI assisted code, settings text, translations and page content.[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#9ACAF7]🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4]For bugs, include your mod/edition, game and SMAPI versions, platform, expected versus actual result, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log link[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if useful. For suggestions, explain the change and how it would help.[/size]
